open_points.subject: FlowEdge propagation from an unexecuted source
open_points.question: Which source-node statuses make an outgoing edge count as coming from a “skipped node”: only `skipped_by_guard`, or also `upstream_failed` and any other status in which the source was not executed?
options: Every source node that produced no value

open_points.subject: NodeExecution status precedence
open_points.question: Does `upstream_failed` win only when guard exhaustion and upstream failure affect the same input port, or whenever they affect any two input ports of the same node execution?
options: It wins across the whole node execution
It wins only when both conditions affect the same input port
open_points.default_guess: It wins across the whole node execution.

open_points.subject: Constant-fed input and node skipping
open_points.text: a port fed by a constant receives it and is never skipped
open_points.question: Does the constant merely prevent its target input port from causing `skipped_by_guard`, leaving the node skippable because another input cannot receive a value, or does any constant-fed port prevent the whole node from being skipped?
options: Only the constant-fed input port is satisfied
Any constant-fed input prevents the whole node from being skipped
open_points.default_guess: Only the constant-fed input port is satisfied; another unsatisfied input can still skip the node.

open_points.subject: Mapped node guard skipping
open_points.text: A node one of whose input ports can no longer receive a value ... is not executed and is recorded `skipped_by_guard`
open_points.question: For a mapped node, is this decision and its `skipped_by_guard` NodeExecution recorded independently for each `map_index`, or does one unavailable mapped input skip the node as a whole?
options: Skip and record the mapped node as a whole

open_points.subject: Input port with no producer
open_points.text: every edge into that port is disabled by its guard or comes from a skipped node
open_points.question: What happens when an input port has neither an incoming edge nor a constant: is the flow refused during proof, or can it run and cause the node to be recorded `skipped_by_guard`?
options: The node is recorded `skipped_by_guard` at run time
